adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `refreshOAuthTokens` only switches to the remote sync endpoint when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (so team creds with `userId` null use the local provider refresh). But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to the minimal schema based only on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`, with no `userId` check. This mismatch is verifiable in the new files. For team credentials (or any local refresh when the endpoint env var is set), the token response will still be parsed with the minimal schema, which (as a `z.object`) will strip unknown keys like `refresh_token`, then the helper forcibly sets `refresh_token` to the string "refresh_token". Call sites like Office365 merge `tokenResponse.data` into stored credentials, so this can overwrite a real refresh token and corrupt persisted keys.
